about: BATCH 14 ENTRY 25 (Kunal's pick 'Before and after', 19 Nov 2026). The Puzzles tab's only advantage bar is the drill's (drill-eval, top row of the brilliant-moves and mistakes drills): hidden while he thinks, and after any move on the card, right or wrong, it reads '<before> -> <after>' from his side. Graded by gate 185 on a trial bundle at kunal761 (375x761, ct_safe 51,31) and 320x568, with the result state also read at the text sizes of gates 177/178 (300x609, 750x1522, 573x1243 and 256x454 as page-zoom sheets): no bar or painted value before the move; values pinned to the material on the board (a queen up; a queen against a hanging rook, then Qd7+?? Kxd7 a rook down; the same for Black); before kept and after re-read on the next try; the top row and the board unmoved; the two values whole. The real code passes everywhere; three ways the fix could come undone are each caught. NOT COVERED: the mistakes drill itself (the same render and the same engine path; gate 185 drives the brilliant-moves drill), mate labels (no card here ends in mate), iOS Safari, his own look on the phone.

breaks.name: bar-only-on-a-solve
breaks.why: the bar comes up only on a solve or Show move again, as before the fix: a wrong move shows nothing, so 'every result, right or wrong' fails

breaks.name: before-read-from-after
breaks.why: the 'before' value reads the position after his move, so it shows after -> after and never where it was: a wrong move reads negative before

breaks.name: bar-up-while-he-thinks
breaks.why: the bar is drawn as soon as the card's own position is searched, before he moves: it gives the hint his pick rules out
